notes: Snakes and Ladders now has a winding stone path with lush jungle gaps, larger open-mouth snakes and a separate dice dock that keeps all100live squares visible. Existing board positions, dice rules, saves and turns are preserved. Fixes games loading while the app is backgrounded: late startup now inherits background state, timers and decorative animations pause, and returning restores the same game while respecting explicit pauses. Includes the six new card and party games plus the fresh-room and Pool fixes from1.0.66. Existing game designs, rankings, profiles and saved scores are retained.
